papers.title_en: RIDGE: State-Conditioned Reward Blending for Behavioral Coverage in Deep RL Game Agents
papers.authors: AL Muqshith Mohammed Shifan, Kevin Christopher Chua, Ali Neshati, Loutfouz Zaman, Cristiano Politowski
papers.evidence: 面向游戏智能体的深度强化学习奖励混合方法
papers.tldr: 在深度强化学习（RL）中，智能体若使用固定人格奖励，就只会表现出单一风格；若要覆盖 N 种风格，就需训练 N 个智能体。而如果在回合中切换奖励，又会让 PPO 因奖励非平稳而退化。RIDGE 用状态条件混合器，从变化缓慢的状态变量计算经 softmax 归一化的 sigmoid 权重，并配一个多价值头评论家；每个价值头都在各自平稳的人格信号上训练。在 Crafter 的四种人格下，单个 RIDGE 智能体同时掌握木级制作与战斗两条分支，固定人格基线无法联合做到；锐度消融表明，状态条件化是性能增益来源。
papers.abstract_en: A deep RL agent trained on a fixed persona reward plays one way: an Explorer keeps exploring while starving, a Survivor hoards on an empty map. Since each persona fixes its own reward, automated playtesting trains N agents for N styles. Changing reward composition mid-episode runs into the switching-stability dilemma: PPO degrades under non-stationary rewards. We present RIDGE, a single-agent architecture that sidesteps the dilemma with two design choices: a state-conditioned blender that computes softmax-normalized sigmoid weights from slow-moving state variables, and a multi-head critic that trains one value head per persona on its own stationary signal. On Crafter with four personas, one \ridge agent acquires both branches of the wood-tier crafting/combat split that no fixed-persona baseline solves jointly, and a sharpness ablation confirms state-conditioning drives the gain. We position these results as demonstrations of the blending mechanism's dynamics across n=3 seeds per condition; larger multi-seed sweeps remain future work.

papers.title_en: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
papers.authors: Kejian Zhu, Zhuoran Jin, Shangqing Tu, Tianyi Men, Yupu Hao, Jiachun Li, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao
papers.evidence: 分析多轮智能体强化学习在轮次与采样预算下的收益
papers.tldr: 多轮智能体强化学习在长程任务上表现突出，但性能增益对交互轮次预算高度敏感。作者用 Pass@(K,T) 从采样宽度 K 与交互深度 T 评估，发现轨迹级 RL 优势依赖充足轮次预算，预算收紧时显著衰减。智能体 RL 并非普遍提升单步决策，而是集中在错误恢复与长程韧性；为此提出训练中变化交互预算的 BudgetMix RL。实验表明其在多种执行设置下更稳健，为预算受限部署提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

papers.title_en: Where It Breaks: Diagnosing Perception, Memory, and Decision Failures of a Vision-Language Agent in Pac-Man
papers.authors: Xinglu Wang, Edward Wang, Yong Zhang, Zhenan Fan
papers.evidence: 视觉语言智能体玩吃豆人，结合强化学习策略研究诊断感知、记忆与决策失效
papers.tldr: 在Pac-Man中仅用四方向动作训练视觉语言智能体时，性能不佳究竟源于读屏还是长序列决策并不清楚。作者以Qwen3.5-9B智能体为对象，分别做感知检查与基于文本棋盘的原始策略强化学习研究。策略优化后，八个留出迷宫完成率从0%升至选定检查点的80.2%（三条额外生命），但静态截图读得准仍可能在交互中出错。研究据此提出训练后应评估使用中的感知、区分训练成功与整局验证，并关注决策与后续表现而非单一分数。
papers.abstract_en: Training an agent to play Pac-Man with only up, down, left and right actions raises a basic question: when performance is poor, what should be improved? Difficulty can arise from reading the screen or from choosing actions over a long sequence. We examine these problems in a Qwen3.5-9B-based agent through separate perception checks and primitive-policy reinforcement-learning studies. In the policy study, which uses textual boards to remove image transcription from the decision interface, completion on eight held-out mazes increased from 0% before this optimization to 80.2% at a selected checkpoint, with three extra lives. The perception checks show that accurate static screenshot reading can coexist with errors during interaction. A separate policy comparison also shows that further optimization can accompany worse action choices. Together, these findings motivate concrete checks for post-training: evaluate perception in use, distinguish training success from full-game validation, and examine decisions and later performance rather than relying on one selected score. The study provides empirical lessons for improving future agent training and evaluation.

papers.title_en: GIST: Gibbs-Targeted Hierarchical Data Selection for Offline RLVR
papers.authors: Xuliang Huang, Tianxiang Zhao, Chengwei Qin, Yao Shu
papers.evidence: 面向离线可验证奖励强化学习的Gibbs目标分层数据选择
papers.tldr: 离线RLVR通常在固定采样池上训练，并对每条回答的全部token等权监督，但不同回答与token的信息量差异显著。GIST以KL正则化RLVR的Gibbs最优策略为训练目标，用双向KL度量策略与目标的失配，并据此设计回答级和token级的两层数据选择：按采样温度选正确回答及靠近策略众数的错误回答，并用初始策略概率只监督失配集中的token。该方法在三个模型和两种离线目标上均提升GSM8K、MATH-500与MBPP平均准确率，受控实验还以少监督66.6%的token超越七个选择基线。其贡献在于把理论失配信号转化为训练前可用的数据选择准则，提高离线RLVR的监督效率。
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains on a fixed pool of sampled responses and typically supervises every token of every response, although responses and tokens are not equally informative. We study which ones to supervise through the Gibbs-optimal policy of KL-regularized RLVR, which offline training targets, and measure the mismatch between a policy and this target with a bidirectional KL divergence. At the reference policy, this mismatch factorizes exactly and separates the two outcomes: correct responses contribute mainly through the forward term, concentrated on their low-probability tokens, and incorrect responses through the reverse term, concentrated on the responses the policy generates often and on their high-probability tokens. Based on this analysis, we propose GIST (Gibbs-Targeted Hierarchical Data Selection), a two-level selection method that approximates these principles with signals available before training. GIST uses the sampling temperature to select correct responses on-policy and incorrect responses near the policy's mode, and it uses the initial policy's token probabilities to supervise only the tokens where the mismatch lies. Applied to two offline training objectives, GIST raises the average accuracy over GSM8K, MATH-500, and MBPP for all three models under both objectives. In a controlled comparison on Qwen3-0.6B/GSM8K, it outperforms seven selection baselines that choose from the same candidates while supervising 66.6% fewer tokens than training on all candidates of the same prompts.

papers.title_en: Using Experience Twice: Dynamic Process Rubrics for Privileged Token-Level Credit Assignment
papers.authors: Shumao Wu, Kongcheng Zhang, Jianqiang Huang, Baisheng Lai
papers.evidence: 借助过程评分规则实现令牌级信用分配
papers.tldr: 智能体轨迹常混合成功决策与失败尝试，稀疏轨迹奖励难以定位应强化或抑制的关键决策。ORSD将同组策略轨迹差异蒸馏为自然语言过程评分细则，经冻结验证器筛选后作为特权信息，比较有无细则时的token似然差，形成密集过程信用并加性塑形GRPO优势。在ALFWorld与WebShop上，相同交互预算下Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-4B的策略改进更快、最终任务表现更高。该工作把轨迹级结果监督与细粒度过程监督连接起来，实现token级信用分配。
papers.abstract_en: Agent trajectories often contain both successful decisions and failed attempts, yet optimization with sparse trajectory-level rewards struggles to identify which critical decisions should be reinforced or suppressed. We observe that meaningful distinctions among on-policy trajectories can be distilled into natural-language process rubrics and used as process supervision signals. Based on this insight, we propose Online Rubric Self-Distillation (ORSD), which leverages self-derived process rubrics for dense token-level supervision, thereby augmenting outcome-centric reinforcement learning. Specifically, the current policy independently generates multiple rubric bundles at each step according to the same group of trajectories, extracting candidate process rubrics from cross-trajectory behavioral differences. A frozen verifier then evaluates all rubric items against each trajectory in the group, and selects one candidate bundle based on bundle-level alignment between rubric satisfaction and task success. ORSD treats the selected rubric bundle as privileged information during training, then compares the log-likelihoods of the original tokens with and without the rubric. The resulting likelihood gap provides token-specific process credit, which is added to the original trajectory-level GRPO advantage through additive advantage shaping. ORSD thus bridges trajectory-level outcome supervision and fine-grained process supervision, enabling token-level credit assignment using process signals. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that ORSD accelerates policy improvement and boosts final task performance for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B under the same environment-interaction budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/AnnaXChun/ORSD.

papers.title_en: Diversity-Aware Experience Replay via Statistical Leverage Scores
papers.evidence: 面向离策略深度强化学习的多样性感知回放采样，提升探索与样本效率
papers.tldr: 机器人离策略强化学习的回放缓冲区常被大量近乎重复的常规转移占据，定义任务边界的稀有事件采样不足。本文用统计杠杆分数衡量每条转移相对缓冲区自身数据的异常程度，仅依赖已存数值、无需标签奖励或价值网络，并按该分数与均匀采样混合抽取小批量。针对one-hot动作使方差排序失效、重要性权重完全抵消增益及关系型稀有信号难由单条转移体现，作者改用峰度最大的重尾特征列并对短轨迹窗口做目标相对描述。在三关节机械臂绕障推物任务上，稀有任务成功率由0.49升至0.69，接近有标签oracle上限0.74。
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy deep reinforcement learning trains on random samples from a replay buffer of past experience. In physical robot settings, that buffer is dominated by routine: thousands of near-identical transitions from normal operation, while the rare events that define the edges of the task are rarely sampled. We propose scoring every stored transition by its statistical leverage, which measures how unusual it is relative to the buffer's own data, computed from the stored numbers alone, with no labels, rewards, or value network. We draw each mini-batch from a mixture of this score and uniform sampling. First, the natural way to build the score along the directions where the data varies most turns out to be blind when actions are stored as one-hot indicators, because indicator columns always win the variance ranking; we instead select the feature columns with the heaviest tails (largest kurtosis) where small far-away populations are revealed. Second, the importance weights that prioritized replay uses to keep gradients unbiased cancel the method exactly: with full correction, training matches uniform sampling, so we drop the correction and deliberately optimize the rebalanced objective. Third, when the rare situations of a log are relational, visible only in how a stretch of behavior relates to its goal, not in any single stored coordinate-per-transition scores are blind; applying the same tail rule to short trajectory windows described relative to their goal restores the signal, and on a three-joint arm that must push an object around an obstacle it raises the rare-task success from 0.49 to 0.69 against a labeled-oracle ceiling of 0.74.

papers.title_en: Reward Budgeting Reduces Premature Convergence in Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
papers.authors: Mengni Jia, Mengyu Zhou, Xiaoxi Jiang, Guanjun Jiang
papers.evidence: 面向大模型推理强化学习的奖励预算优势构造
papers.tldr: RL训练LLM推理时，策略分布变尖会导致性能过早平台；仅提高熵并不能稳定改变平台。作者从隐式目标策略推导尖锐度因子κ及有效κ_eff，并提出奖励预算：为每个提示分配固定总奖励预算来构造优势。在Qwen3-8B与Llama3.2-3B-Instruct上，该方法提升多种RL基线，AMC23最高+12.50，AIME24/25最高+10.00。结果表明可从更新动力学理解过早收敛，且无需显式保持熵也能获得显著收益。
papers.abstract_en: RL for LLM reasoning often reaches an early performance plateau as the policy distribution becomes increasingly sharp. Recent work has studied policy entropy as both a diagnostic and a control signal for this behavior. In our experiments, however, increasing entropy alone does not reliably change the eventual plateau. We analyze RL through its implicit target policy and derive a sharpness factor $κ$, together with an effective counterpart $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$, that describes how strongly reward or advantage gaps are translated into probability-ratio gaps. Motivated by this view, we introduce \emph{reward budgeting}, a plug-in advantage construction that assigns a fixed total reward budget to each prompt. For binary rewards and independent on-policy rollouts, its unclipped score-function estimator follows the gradient of an exact finite-$G$ concave objective with diminishing returns, while its advantage gap decreases as more rollouts become correct. For general rewards, a shifted log-mean interpretation holds asymptotically under the stated regularity conditions. These results motivate, rather than establish exact objective equivalence for, the clipped implementations. On Qwen3-8B and Llama3.2-3B-Instruct, reward budgeting consistently improves a range of RL baselines, with gains up to +12.50 on AMC23 and +10.00 on AIME24 and AIME25. Overall, our results support an update-dynamics view of premature convergence and show that strong gains can be obtained without explicitly preserving entropy.

papers.title_en: Rubric Curriculum RL: Exploiting the Generation-Verification Gap in Non-Verifiable Domains
papers.authors: Sumeet Ramesh Motwani, Tejas Krishnan, Alistair Letcher, Charles London, Suhaas Bhat, Huitian Jiao, Philip Torr, Riashat Islam, Christopher Summerfield, Jakob Foerster, Christian Schroeder de Witt, Qilong Gu, Shital Shah
papers.evidence: 通过评分标准课程将可验证奖励强化学习扩展到不可验证领域
papers.tldr: 在开放域中，RLVR 因缺少可验证真值、人工标注昂贵且奖励模型易被钻空子而难以扩展。RcRL 利用“生成难、验证易”的差距，将多次采样的成对偏好与 rubric 准则课程结合，形成更具判别力且非平稳的奖励信号。方法无需新数据、人工标注或更强教师模型，在创意写作对基座模型取得 70.5% 人类胜率，并在 HealthBench 全集和共识子集分别提升 14.6% 和 25.4%。它缓解了基线数百步即平台化的问题，输出熵保持更久，持续训练超过 1000 步仍能改进。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has led to significant gains in math and code generation. Extending these gains to open-ended domains remains challenging: ground-truth verification is unavailable, human annotation is expensive, and learned reward models are prone to reward hacking. The generation-verification gap, where judging good outputs is easier than producing them, offers a potential path to improvement. However, rubric-based judges are often imprecise and stationary, so policies can overfit or reward hack them. We introduce Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL), which exploits this gap without new data, human annotations, or stronger teacher models. We combine pairwise preferences over rollouts with a curriculum over rubric criteria, yielding a more discriminative signal than absolute scoring and a non-stationary objective. Whereas baselines plateau within a few hundred steps, RcRL preserves output entropy and keeps improving past 1000 steps. On creative writing, RcRL achieves a 70.5% human win rate against the base model, with gains across benchmarks and judges. On HealthBench, RcRL improves over the base model by 14.6% (full set) and 25.4% (consensus subset), outperforming all training baselines, including instance-specific rubrics.

papers.title_en: SUMONE: A Simple and Efficient Summarizer for Plug-and-Play Agent Memory
papers.authors: Jizhe Zhang, Ang Li, Chenheng Zhang, Yisen Wang
papers.evidence: 面向长程智能体记忆压缩的任务无关摘要器，使用GRPO训练
papers.tldr: 长程语言模型智能体的交互历史不断膨胀，上下文压缩成为高效执行的关键，但已有学习式压缩方法依赖下游任务结果或求解器行为，训练与特定任务和智能体强耦合。SumOne 是一个独立训练的摘要器，借助掩码重建提供任务无关奖励，用 GRPO 优化摘要质量并施加长度惩罚。推理时只保留轻量摘要器，即可为不改动的智能体提供即插即用的上下文压缩。在 DeepSearchQA 与 SWE-bench Verified 上，估计推理成本分别降低约 78% 和 75%，且同一检查点可跨模型与智能体框架迁移。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language-model agents accumulate increasingly large interaction histories, making context compaction essential for efficient execution. Existing learned compaction methods often rely on downstream task outcomes or solver behavior, coupling training to specific tasks or agents. We introduce SumOne, a standalone summarizer trained to preserve information in agent histories through masked reconstruction. Given a summary of the expired history, a frozen reconstructor recovers randomly masked portions of the original trajectory; reconstruction quality, combined with a length penalty, provides a task-agnostic reward for optimizing the summarizer with GRPO. This yields self-supervision directly from raw trajectories, without reference summaries or downstream task execution. At inference time, only the lightweight summarizer is retained, enabling plug-and-play context compression for otherwise unchanged agents. We conduct a systematic evaluation of SumOne in long-horizon search and software-engineering tasks. SumOne reduces estimated inference cost by approximately 78\% on DeepSearchQA and 75\% on SWE-bench Verified relative to operating with full context, with absolute decreases of 0.04. The same checkpoint also transfers across downstream models and agent harnesses without additional fine-tuning.

papers.title_en: H^2MARL: Hierarchical Heterogeneous Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Robot Control
papers.authors: Xuemin Hu, Kaixin Li, Qingqing Xia, Yuxin Wang, Wei Xie, Bo Tang, Long Chen
papers.evidence: 分层异构多智能体强化学习
papers.tldr: 人形机器人全身控制受高维耦合动力学与关节自由度物理异质性制约，现有MARL分区粗糙且分层规划与执行脱节。H^2MARL在JDoF级构建物理异质性感知的策略分解，并以共享轨迹闭环协同优化高层姿态规划器与低层关节执行器。MuJoCo和Isaac Gym实验显示其提升运动稳定性、步态协调与动作质量。该框架为异质关节的人形全身控制提供统一分层多智能体方案。
papers.abstract_en: Coordinated whole-body control of humanoid robots remains challenging due to high-dimensional coupled dynamics and substantial physical heterogeneity across joint degrees of freedom (JDoFs). Existing multi-agent reinforcement learning methods either employ coarse agent partitions or directly apply generic heterogeneous-agent algorithms, while hierarchical controllers commonly optimize high-level planning and low-level execution independently, leading to uncoordinated motion. In this paper, we propose H^2MARL, a hierarchical heterogeneous multi-agent reinforcement learning framework with two key mechanisms. We first formulate humanoid whole-body control using a JDoF-level physical-heterogeneity-aware policy factorization, where each torque-actuated JDoF is conditioned on an explicit descriptor of its actuation, kinematic, and dynamic properties. Moreover, we develop a closed-loop policy-executor co-optimization mechanism that jointly adapts the high-level pose planner and the low-level joint executor using shared interaction trajectories, thereby reducing the distribution mismatch between planning and execution. Extensive experiments in MuJoCo and Isaac Gym demonstrate that H^2MARL consistently improves locomotion stability, gait coordination, and motion quality over homogeneous, coarse-grained, and independently optimized alternatives.

papers.title_en: Visual Token Routing: Learning to keep tokens that matter
papers.evidence: 面向视觉语言计算机使用智能体的稀疏视觉token路由，适用于游戏等长程任务
papers.tldr: 计算机使用智能体把每张截图编码为数千视觉 token，长历史累积使推理成本高。VTR 联合训练视觉语言模型与轻量时空路由器，逐区域决定当前及上一截图的 token 是否进入语言模型，并用自适应损失平衡稀疏化与性能。仅训练 2000 步，VTR 在 OSWorld、CUA-World 和游戏预测上匹配全分辨率模型，视觉 token 减少 2.5–5.8 倍，推理成本降 3.3 倍。让智能体处理必要 token，为长时程与实时应用降低计算门槛。
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have recently achieved superhuman performance on several long-horizon benchmarks. However, their computational cost limits their use in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains such as video games. A key bottleneck is representing each screenshot as thousands of visual tokens, which accumulate into long contexts as agents reason over extended interaction histories. We observe that most of these visual tokens are either semantically irrelevant to the agent's next action or temporally redundant across screenshots. Building on this observation, we introduce Visual Token Routing (VTR), a joint training framework for learning sparse visual representations that preserve the information needed for action prediction. In VTR, we train the vision-language model together with a lightweight spatio-temporal router that examines each image region in the current and previous screenshots and decides whether its visual token enters the language model. We optimize the router using an adaptive loss to keep the number of visual tokens as small as possible while minimizing performance degradation. With just 2,000 training steps, VTR matches the performance of the full-resolution model on OSWorld, CUA-World, and video game action prediction, while using 2.5-5.8x fewer visual tokens. These savings reduce inference cost by up to 3.3x and speed up prefill by up to 2.9x. VTR also outperforms lowering the image resolution and other baselines for dropping tokens, by up to 12.8 points on OSWorld. Overall, VTR enables computer-use agents to process only the visual tokens they need, allowing them to be used in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains at a fraction of the computational cost. Code and models are available at https://pranjal2041.github.io/vtr

papers.title_en: Near-Minimax Sample Complexity for Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning under Generative Models
papers.evidence: 生成模型下多目标强化学习的近极小极大样本复杂度
papers.tldr: 多目标强化学习中偏好常在数据采集后才确定，需用单一数据集支持连续奖励权衡。作者在生成模型下研究未知转移、已知多奖励的有限折扣MDP，要求对所有奖励凸组合同时给出ε最优策略。方法采用均匀状态-动作采样与经验规划，并在对数目标区做奖励舍入，分析借助奖励凸包覆盖和单侧Bellman方差界。所得样本复杂度为Θ~(SAH^3/ε^2·min{S,log(em)})，并给出匹配下界，表明支持全部偏好的统计成本随目标数对数增长、至状态数饱和。
papers.abstract_en: In multi-objective reinforcement learning, preferences may be specified only after data collection, requiring one dataset to support a continuum of reward trade-offs. We study finite discounted Markov decision processes with unknown transitions, $S$ states, $A$ actions, and $m$ known reward functions taking values in $[0,1]$, given access to a generative model. The learner must provide an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy for every convex combination of these rewards without further sampling, with a guarantee that holds simultaneously over all preferences and initial states. Writing $H=(1-γ)^{-1}$, we establish the constant-confidence minimax sample complexity $\widetildeΘ\!\left(   \frac{SAH^3}{\varepsilon^2}\min\{S,\log(em)\} \right)$, where the suppressed factors are logarithmic in $S,A,H,\varepsilon^{-1}$ and the dependence on $m$ is explicit. Thus, up to these logarithmic factors, the worst-case statistical cost of supporting all preferences grows logarithmically with the number of objectives and saturates at the number of states. The upper bound uses uniform state--action sampling and empirical planning, with reward rounding in the logarithmic-objective regime. Its analysis chains optimal-value increments over covers of the reward hull. A one-sided Bellman variance bound controls signed value differences under a second transition kernel, preserving the $H^3\varepsilon^{-2}$ dependence. A complementary uniform guarantee for all bounded rewards yields the state-dimension saturation. We establish lower bounds matching up to logarithmic factors through a rare-exit construction with subset rewards and action encoding. These bounds apply to adaptive simulator queries and arbitrary randomized history-dependent output policies, while the upper bounds are attained by deterministic stationary policies.

papers.title_en: Revisiting Critic Estimation in Soft Actor-Critic Algorithms
papers.authors: Jan Felix Kleuker, Koen Ponse, Aske Plaat, Thomas M. Moerland
papers.evidence: 重新审视软演员-评论家深度强化学习的评论家设计以提升稳定性
papers.tldr: SAC通常用一步时序差分学习Q函数，批评器设计仍待探索。本文固定策略目标，在14个任务上通过随机超参搜索比较六种批评器变体，涵盖优势、dueling优势、λ-return与soft GAE，并区分在线和回放轨迹段训练。结果显示优势批评器无增益，soft GAE不优于λ-return；回放轨迹段训练的λ-return批评器在连续控制上明显提升，且无需重要性加权或trace cutting。该工作把未校正多步目标在回放下有效的证据扩展到含熵项的soft λ-return，并提示可推广到更广强化学习算法。
papers.abstract_en: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is a widely used deep reinforcement learning algorithm that combines entropy regularization with an actor-critic architecture. Standard implementations rely on one-step temporal-difference learning of Q-functions, yet alternative critic design choices remain underexplored. In this work, we revisit three such choices: learning soft advantages instead of soft Q-values, the use of multi-step return targets, and the training of multi-step critics from replay buffer data. Keeping the policy objective fixed, we compare the six critic variants these choices generate: (i) advantage and (ii) dueling-advantage critics learned from one-step transitions, and $λ$-return and soft Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE) critics learned either (iii, iv) on-policy or (v, vi) from replayed trajectory segments. Each variant is evaluated across an entire random hyperparameter search on fourteen tasks, treating the hyperparameters as part of the algorithm. Learning soft advantages instead of soft Q-values does not improve performance, and the soft GAE critic adds nothing over the simpler $λ$-return critic. What does improve performance, most clearly on continuous control, is training a $λ$-return critic on replayed trajectory segments, even without importance weighting or trace cutting. This extends earlier evidence that uncorrected multi-step targets work well under replay to the full soft $λ$-return, entropy terms included. By design, the underlying ideas studied here extend beyond SAC, and our empirical findings aim to encourage their application to a broader class of reinforcement learning algorithms.

papers.title_en: TandemBench: Benchmarking Decision Models for Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.authors: Baohang Li, Xiaocheng Feng, Bing Qin
papers.evidence: 面向多智能体协作与团队计划选择的基准
papers.tldr: 多智能体协作中，团队计划选择直接影响分工、资源交换与并行执行，但现有决策模型评测多聚焦单步选项。论文提出 TandemBench，用1200道多智能体烹饪题提供全局信息与候选团队计划，并以执行和精确搜索建立参考答案。评测40个原生决策模型与10个通用语言模型，最佳原生模型决策准确率仅62.50%。配对最优性检验进一步揭示，仅看计划选择准确率会掩盖模型判断候选是否含最优方案的系统性错误。
papers.abstract_en: Decision models choose among predefined options in tasks such as routing and action selection. In multi-agent collaboration, a decision determines how members divide work, exchange resources, and act in parallel. We introduce TandemBench, a benchmark of 1,200 questions in multi-agent cooking scenarios where coordination choices affect goal completion. Models receive complete global information and candidate team plans, with reference answers established through execution and exact search. Models select an optimal team plan and, in paired variants that retain or remove it, judge whether better arrangements exist beyond the supplied options. We evaluate 40 native decision models and compare them with 10 general-purpose language models. The best native decision model achieves 62.50% decision accuracy. Native decision models remain close to chance in optimality verification. Paired tests reveal that some report better alternatives regardless of whether an optimal plan is already present. These findings show that team-plan decision accuracy alone can conceal systematic errors in judging whether the supplied options contain an optimal arrangement. The dataset and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/lililibaohang/TandemBench.

papers.title_en: Graph-Mediated Large Language Model Systems in the Agentic Era: Reasoning, Knowledge, Retrieval, Execution, and Coordination
papers.authors: Haihui Liu, Yang Chen, Zice Qiu, Yun Zhang, Jialun Zhong, Wenhua Wang, Yanzeng Li, Tian Wang
papers.evidence: 综述图结构在大模型智能体系统中的推理、记忆与协作
papers.tldr: 针对图结构在大模型系统中作用日益重要却难以区分其功能的问题，本文系统梳理了图介导的大模型智能体系统。作者提出按操作层面划分的角色-位置分类法，覆盖推理、知识证据、检索记忆、执行与多智能体协调等环节。综述明确了每种图操作的功能、计算主体与输出用途，为理解与设计智能体系统提供了统一框架。该分类有助于厘清记忆与协调机制在大模型智能体中的作用。
papers.abstract_en: Graphs play an increasingly important role in large language model (LLM) systems, supporting structural reasoning, knowledge grounding, retrieval, and memory. As these systems evolve toward the agentic era, graphs also organize execution dependencies and multi-agent communication, linking intermediate observations and retained information to subsequent decisions. However, understanding their contribution requires distinguishing the function of each graph operation, the component responsible for its computation, and the subsequent use of its output. This survey introduces an operation-level role--locus taxonomy for reasoning, knowledge and evidence, retrieval and memory, execution, and coordination. We compare how graph observations and external computations guide decisions, how memory representations and updates support later tasks, and how dependencies constrain execution and information delivery. These comparisons distinguish improvements in local metrics from downstream task performance while retaining the conditions under which results were reported. We then organize benchmarks, comparison designs, process diagnostics, and system costs into an evaluation framework. Finally, we identify open challenges in adaptive computation and stopping, memory maintenance, and dependency-aware recovery. The survey provides a basis for assessing when graph mechanisms are useful and for evaluating their effects across components and stages.

papers.title_en: ModalSearcher: Weaving Visual Evidence into Autonomous Cross-Modal Deep Search
papers.authors: Zhihan Yin, Ruyi Li, Chengyu Fang, Yifeng Yao, Nonghai Zhang, Pengfei Xiong, Terry Zhang, Huishuai Zhang, Dongyan Zhao
papers.evidence: 智能体多模态搜索与动态工具选择
papers.tldr: 针对现有多模态智能体搜索将视觉证据固定在输入或预设轨迹位置、难以随信息需求演化切换模态的问题，论文提出自主跨模态搜索能力，让智能体在直接推理、文搜文、文搜图与反图搜之间动态选择，并跨多跳整合证据。ModalSearcher据此实现复杂真实查询下的模态切换与视觉证据主动引入，为多模态大模型的智能体式工具使用与规划提供了更灵活的框架。
papers.abstract_en: Static and incomplete parametric knowledge limits the performance of multimodal large language models on novel-knowledge and knowledge-intensive tasks, especially those requiring multi-hop evidence acquisition. Existing multimodal agentic search methods often fix visual evidence at the input or a predefined trajectory position, making it difficult for agents to select search modalities as their information needs evolve and to handle complex real-world queries. We define this capability as autonomous cross-modal search: an agent chooses among direct reasoning, text-to-text search, text-to-image search, and reverse-image search, actively introduces visual evidence when appropriate, and switches between and integrates modalities across multiple hops. We propose ModalSearch-Pipeline, a scalable procedure for constructing an interleaved multimodal knowledge graph. It samples paths with diverse depths and modality compositions and uses backward question construction to obscure entity names and image targets that would expose reasoning shortcuts while retaining necessary disambiguating clues, yielding text-only, image-initialized, and arbitrarily interleaved multi-hop problems. We train the ModalSearcher Agent with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning in a live Web environment, and construct ModalSearch-Bench. Experiments show that ModalSearcher-8B improves average accuracy by 16.2 points over Qwen3-VL-8B under the same agentic workflow across five multimodal knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks, with consistent gains on independently constructed active visual-search benchmarks.

papers.title_en: HarnessFlow: MCTS-Guided Harness Optimization for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Zhi Hong, Qianlong Wang, Hongchen Wei, Aidan Wu, Daohong Ying, Mingze Kong, Bei Liu, Chong Luo
papers.evidence: 用MCTS策略优化大模型智能体执行框架
papers.tldr: 大模型智能体的表现不仅取决于模型本身，也取决于与工具和环境交互的执行框架，但框架设计长期依赖人工且搜索代价高昂。作者提出HarnessFlow，将候选框架及其评测历史组织为细化树，用基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的策略在有限评测预算下平衡探索与利用，并由编码智能体依据代码与执行反馈迭代改进框架。实验表明该框架能在受限预算内高效优化完整可执行框架，为智能体系统自动化调优提供了可复用的搜索方法。
papers.abstract_en: The performance of large language model (LLM) agents depends on both the underlying model and the harness that governs interaction with tools and the environment. Yet harness design remains largely manual, and automating it requires navigating an open-ended search space through costly end-to-end evaluations. We introduce HarnessFlow, a framework for optimizing complete executable harnesses under a limited candidate-evaluation budget, with the model and task environment held fixed. HarnessFlow organizes candidates and their evaluation histories in a refinement tree, using a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based policy to balance exploitation and exploration. A coding agent refines selected harnesses using archived code, execution feedback, and a library of reusable harness mechanisms. With 15 refinement attempts per benchmark, HarnessFlow achieves the highest mean test scores among the compared methods on six benchmarks spanning agentic tasks, coding, and web interaction. The optimized harnesses achieve an average score of 69.48%, outperforming the initial harnesses and Meta-Harness by 10.89 and 3.95 percentage points, respectively, while incurring lower average per-task execution costs than hand-engineered baselines. These results suggest that structured harness search offers a promising route toward automating the design of capable and efficient LLM agents.
